name: Project NOMAD
description:
Project NOMAD is an offline knowledge and education server with a browser-based Command Center. Install and manage offline Wikipedia and ebooks with Kiwix, educational courses with Kolibri, local AI with Ollama and Qdrant, offline maps, CyberChef, and notes from one interface.

This package includes the Command Center, MySQL, Redis, Dozzle for service logs, and host disk monitoring. Optional tools, AI models, and offline content are installed separately from the NOMAD interface.

compose:
services:
  admin:
    image: ghcr.io/crosstalk-solutions/project-nomad:1.35.1
    container_name: nomad_admin
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - default
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "8080"
      HOST: 0.0.0.0
      URL: http://localhost:8080
      LOG_LEVEL: info
      APP_KEY: ${SECRET_APP_KEY}
      NOMAD_STORAGE_PATH: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage
      DB_HOST: mysql
      DB_PORT: "3306"
      DB_DATABASE: nomad
      DB_USER: nomad_user
      DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_SSL: "false"
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      DISABLE_COMPRESSION: "false"
      TZ: $TZ
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage
        target: /app/storage
      - type: bind
        source: /var/run/docker.sock
        target: /var/run/docker.sock
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, curl, -f, 'http://localhost:8080/api/health']
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 120s
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0.45
    container_name: nomad_mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - default
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_DATABASE: nomad
      MYSQL_USER: nomad_user
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      TZ: $TZ
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql
        target: /var/lib/mysql
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, mysqladmin, ping, -h, 127.0.0.1]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 60s
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 512M
  redis:
    image: redis:7.4.8-alpine
    container_name: nomad_redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - default
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis
        target: /data
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, redis-cli, ping]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
  dozzle:
    image: amir20/dozzle:v10.0.7
    container_name: nomad_dozzle
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - default
    environment:
      DOZZLE_ENABLE_ACTIONS: "false"
      DOZZLE_ENABLE_SHELL: "false"
    ports:
      - target: 8080
        published: "9999"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /var/run/docker.sock
        target: /var/run/docker.sock
        read_only: true
  disk-collector:
    image: ghcr.io/crosstalk-solutions/project-nomad-disk-collector:latest
    container_name: nomad_disk_collector
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - default
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /
        target: /host
        read_only: true
        bind:
          propagation: rslave
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage
        target: /storage
# NOMAD attaches the optional tools it creates to this exact network name.
# Explicit service networks keep ZimaOS Compose imports from using network_mode: bridge.
networks:
  default:
    name: project-nomad_default
    driver: bridge
notes: Requires an amd64 device with at least 4 GB RAM and 10 GB free disk space for installation. AI models and offline content require additional resources. Set URL to your device's address, choose a unique APP_KEY of at least 32 characters, and change DB_PASSWORD together with MYSQL_PASSWORD before first start; also change MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD. NOMAD has no login and can manage Docker containers: use it only on a trusted local network. Keep the nomad_admin container name and project-nomad_default network name. Update the Command Center through ZimaOS; the upstream self-updater is not included. Optional tools created by NOMAD are separate containers and must be removed in NOMAD before uninstalling this package.
